item.title: PHILIPS MEDICAL SYSTEMS NEDERLAND B.V.: Philips Azurion S. Model Number: 722285. Recall
item.summary: Solid-State Drives (SSDs) that are not specified in the Medical Device File may have been installed in various PCs. These SSDs may have different performance characteristics, which may include reduced reliability over time such as loss of imaging functionality or motorized movement, a blank or black display, and/or the inability to store newly acquired images or access previously acquired images. Product details: Philips Azurion S. Model Number: 722285.
